description: Source code for ESP socket management in Zephyr-based Wi-Fi driver, including socket lifecycle, packet preparation, data reception, and work queue handling.

methods.name: esp_socket_get
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a socket structure from the socket pool, associating it with a network context.

methods.name: esp_socket_put
methods.description: Clears socket flags, indicating socket release.

methods.name: esp_socket_ref
methods.description: Increments the reference count of a socket, returning the socket if successful.

methods.name: esp_socket_unref
methods.description: Decrements the reference count of a socket and frees resources if count reaches zero.

methods.name: esp_socket_init
methods.description: Initializes all sockets in the data structure, setting up synchronization primitives and work items.

methods.name: esp_socket_rx
methods.description: Handles incoming data on a socket, preparing network packets and invoking receive callbacks.

methods.name: esp_socket_close
methods.description: Closes a socket connection by sending an AT command.

methods.name: esp_socket_workq_stop_and_flush
methods.description: Stops and flushes the socket's work queue, ensuring all pending work is completed.
